title: The Silver Exchange

beats.text: Elias smoothed his uniform in the lobby’s silver mirror, finding comfort in his steady gaze during the lonely shift. Fiction.
beats.image_prompt: monochrome close up of a hotel clerk smoothing a tie in a mirror, dark fog in background

beats.text: Mr. Vane approached the desk, his heavy coat drinking the light as he leaned forward to sign the register.
beats.image_prompt: shadowy man in heavy coat signing a book in a dark hotel lobby, monochrome

beats.text: Behind him, the grand mirror showed only the empty hallway; there was no guest visible in the glass.
beats.image_prompt: antique mirror showing an empty hallway while a man stands before it, monochrome

beats.text: "The mirror never lies," Elias whispered, his fingers trembling as he slid the key across the cold marble.
beats.image_prompt: close up of trembling hand sliding an antique hotel key across a marble counter, monochrome

beats.text: Vane looked up with weary eyes and a thin smile that didn't reach his reflective, silver pupils.
beats.image_prompt: extreme close up of hollow eyes with a silver tint in monochrome lighting

beats.text: "I’ve been looking for a fresh perspective," the guest murmured, his hand brushing Elias’s skin with a freezing touch.
beats.image_prompt: monochrome close up of two hands touching over a counter, cold fog swirling

beats.text: Elias turned back to the glass and gasped as his own reflection began to fade into a gray mist.
beats.image_prompt: a human reflection in a mirror dissolving into smoke and mist, monochrome

beats.text: In its place, Vane’s image solidified in the silver, leaving Elias standing there as a formless shadow.
beats.image_prompt: a man standing inside a mirror looking out while a shadow stands in the room, monochrome
dark, empty hotel lobby at night, monochrome, heavy fog
